case.title: Need an invoice copy with VAT number
case.subject: Invoice October with VAT ID
case.text:
Hello,

Please can you send me the October invoice with our VAT ID DE000000000 on it? Our tax advisor needs it.

Regards,
Thomas Müller
Praxis Müller
case.why: Invoices are self-serve in Settings → Billing → Invoices; VAT number in Billing details (applies to future invoices; past corrected copy via billing).

output.reply:
Hello Thomas,

Thank you for your message. Because the October invoice has already been issued, we cannot add the VAT ID to it ourselves. Changes to Billing details only apply to future invoices. A corrected copy of a past invoice has to be prepared by our billing team, so I have passed your request to them. They will follow up with you directly.

To help them, please reply with the invoice number if you have it, and confirm the company name and address that should appear on the invoice together with VAT ID DE000000000.

In the meantime, the owner of the account can add the VAT ID under Settings → Billing → Billing details so that all future invoices include it. You can find your existing invoices under Settings → Billing → Invoices.

Kind regards,
Slotwise Support

Hello Thomas,

Thanks for your message. You can add your VAT number in Settings → Billing → Billing details, but that only applies to future invoices, so it won't change the October invoice automatically. A corrected copy of a past invoice has to come from our billing team. I've passed your request to them, and a teammate will follow up with you about the October invoice. You can also download the original PDF anytime in Settings → Billing → Invoices.

Slotwise Support
